name: amazon-ml-challenge-2026
description: Amazon ML Challenge 2026: Business Entity Resolution Solution targeting macro-averaged F_0.5 score.
conventions: All TSV files must be read and written with explicit tab separator sep="\t"
Candidate generation (blocking) must achieve >= 95% recall ceiling before filtering
Precision-heavy threshold optimization calibrated specifically for macro-averaged F_0.5
Zero-match singletons must output empty string to receive 1.0 entity score
Country label is treated as open set of strings (US, India, France, etc.) without hardcoding
Source 1 entities can only match Source 2 (S2-*) and Source 3 (S3-*) entities
All final predictions in matching_results.tsv must be a strict subset of candidate_pairs.tsv
architecture_patterns: Two-stage pipeline: High-recall candidate blocking followed by high-precision ML re-ranking
Multi-index blocking: Inverted index on standardized name tokens + n-gram locality + TF-IDF blocking
Rich pairwise feature engineering: Levenshtein, Jaro-Winkler, Token Sort/Set ratios, Address component overlap, Postal/PIN match
GBDT classification with custom F_0.5 objective or post-hoc threshold tuning per country / slice
Strict submission packaging conforming to the competition specification

file_structure.code/business_entity_resolution/src: Data preprocessing, blocking, feature extraction, model training, and inference scripts

testing_strategy.validation_split: Stratified holdout validation set scored via exact macro F_0.5 formula
checks: No self-matches or S1 IDs in matched_entity_ids
All matched IDs exist in test set and candidate pairs

never_do: Never use external lookup APIs, geocoders, or internet queries (strictly prohibited by fair-play rules)
Never hard-code country filters to only US and India (must handle France and any new country)
Never produce duplicate entity IDs in matched_entity_ids
Never match Source 1 entities to Source 1
Never omit any Source 1 entity from matching_results.tsv
Never use models larger than 8B parameters or non-MIT/Apache 2.0 licenses
preferred_patterns: Fast text normalization with regex stripping legal abbreviations (Corp, Ltd, Pvt, LLC) into standardized tokens
Polars for high-speed string processing and dataframe operations
RapidFuzz cdist for ultra-fast vectorized string similarity calculations
LightGBM with stratified K-Fold cross validation and threshold search maximizing F_0.5
